title: Maintenance window 2026-11-29
body: The delta API is read-only on 2026-11-29 between 01:00 and 03:00 UTC. Cursors issued before the window stay valid; clients should retry with backoff.

title: Schema v2.3: tombstones retire SKUs - integrator action required for local price overrides
body: Schema v2.3 (feed epoch 2026.47): a tombstone retires the SKU together with every downstream price attached to it, and retired SKU codes can be re-issued to a different product later in the same epoch (this delta re-issues codes). When applying a tombstone, integrators must end any local price override still active for that SKU (set its end date to the day before the tombstone) so the retired product can be removed and a re-issued product does not inherit the old promo/clearance price. Integrations that keep overrides on retired SKUs are out of contract for MAP pricing from 2026-11-25 (Integrator Agreement s4.2).
